acceptanceCriteria: The owner decides each of the four questions and the decision is recorded in the CAL spec Open decisions and a build-log entry.
If GATE_PASSED stays unsatisfiable, the spec and TASKS-EXTERNAL-AGENTS.md say so explicitly, or a ticket for a gate-result oracle exists.
An independent re-review of the V1-0787 repair commit is recorded, or its absence is accepted by the owner.
body: docs/build-log/2026-10-05-v1-0787-execution-prerequisites.md (at 618680492cf8, merged in #574) lists open owner questions that no ticket tracks: (1) a stageless claim or plan applies every prerequisite (fail closed) rather than none; (2) without a production gate-result oracle a GATE_PASSED prerequisite keeps its stages refused as NOT_OBSERVED forever, so the obligation is never satisfiable today; (3) self-reference is MALFORMED while dependencies use CYCLE; (4) CREATE does not accept executionPrerequisites, so it can only be set by refine. Also: the V1-0787 Codex review returned CHANGES_REQUIRED, all four findings were repaired with regressions, and no re-review approval is recorded.
title: corvint-tasks: owner questions left open by V1-0787 execution prerequisites (issue #585 follow-up)
